cohort: The study participants are Brazilian women and their children from the Pro-Saude Study (1999-2012).
finding: Maternal age, mode of delivery, maternal education, and household income are relevant factors influencing breastfeeding duration, which has shown a decrease among children born in the 1990s and 2000s.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery is a relevant factor influencing breastfeeding duration, especially among primiparous mothers.
